mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime that raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) during quarters with GDPC1 YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and input costs, eroding profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) during periods with UNRATE > 4% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average by more than -3% for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and signals negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12M MA by > -3% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) during INDPRO weakness episodes defined above.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS above 0.4% month-over-month and a fall in UNRATE below 3.5% within the same month signals a labor market deceleration despite employment growth, which increases recession risk and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 0.4% MoM AND UNRATE < 3.5% in same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) during months meeting the dual PAYEMS/UNRATE trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in HOUST below its 6-month moving average by more than -5% for three consecutive months signals weakening housing demand, which negatively impacts construction and homebuilder equities and drags on the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 6M MA by > -5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) during HOUST weakness episodes defined above.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month increase in FEDFUNDS by more than 0.75 percentage points signals an aggressive tightening stance that immediately raises risk-free rates and equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.10 mean excess return) following a FEDFUNDS jump > 0.75% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both GDPC1 and RSAFS for two consecutive quarters indicates a broad-based demand contraction, which reduces corporate revenues and cash flows and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both decline for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) during quarters with simultaneous GDPC1 and RSAFS declines.
